title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Scam, Phishing, and Rug-Pull Defence

questions.text: Why are unlimited token approvals particularly dangerous when interacting with smart contracts?
options: They lock your wallet completely from taking any future transactions.
They allow a malicious smart contract to drain your entire token balance rather than just the deposit amount.
They permanently change your hardware wallet security settings.
They prevent you from revoking permissions in the future.
questions.explanation: An unlimited token approval grants a contract access to your full token balance, enabling a bad actor to drain the entire wallet.

questions.text: True or false: To protect against phishing, you should search for official dApps via search engine advertisements instead of using bookmarked links.
questions.explanation: You should use verified bookmarks rather than search engine ads, as scammers frequently buy top ad spots to promote fake sites.
